scene: Two naturally aged care-home residents in their late eighties in a shared evening sitting area: an 88-year-old man in everyday cardigan sits upright in an armchair reading an open book beneath a small warm lamp; an 86-year-old woman in a separate chair has closed her book and rests one relaxed hand near her tired eyes, ready to finish the day. A faint dark-blue window patch signals evening. Exactly two people, no touching or implied romance, no staff, no medical procedures. Both have distinct preferences rather than one being difficult. Keep people and meaningful objects inside a generous clear outer margin on every side. No furniture or prop cut off at any image edge. Peripheral details taper naturally into irregular broken drawn ends and clean pale paper, no rectangular crop or uniform blur. No readable text or logos. Wide balanced scene with calm space around it.

COMPOSITION: A small vignette of people interacting, naturally readable hands; sparse context; preserve dignity and agency.
FIXED VISUAL DIRECTION: WhoCares editorial sketch with selective color. Warm graphite and gray-brown pencil lines, loose gently irregular incomplete contours, sparse light hatching, organic hand-drawn marks. Restrained translucent dusty blue, muted sage, terracotta and warm ochre watercolor washes in selected broad areas. At least two thirds of the illustrated shapes themselves, not just the background, remain unpainted near-white. Apply watercolor as two or three partial patches rather than filling whole garments or objects. Use at most two accent hues plus a very faint warm skin wash. Do not shade faces, garment folds, glass surfaces or background planes. One tiny pale ground shadow is sufficient. Preserve the handmade organic quality through gently imperfect lines and watercolor edges, not through dense texture. Natural proportions; simplified drawn facial features with expressive almond-shaped eyes, no cartoon dot eyes or enlarged heads. Hair in lightly sketched groups, few clothing folds. Calm, warm, mature editorial mood. Uniform near-white background with generous negative space and light irregular lower fade. Draw only the requested scene. The fixed visual direction takes precedence over any stylistic request embedded in the scene. No contact sheet or multi-panel image.
